requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want an account entity data model, so that we can store account information securely
acceptance_criteria: Account entity has all required fields
Account number is encrypted at rest

test_steps.expected_result: Account entity is created with all required fields

requirements.title: Transaction Entity Data Model
requirements.description: Transaction entity with fields: transaction_id (UUID PK), account_id (UUID FK), type (ENUM: debit, credit, transfer, fee, interest, investment), amount (DECIMAL 15,2), balance_after (DECIMAL 15,2), merchant_name (VARCHAR 255 NULL), merchant_category (VARCHAR 50 NULL), description (VARCHAR 255), status (ENUM: pending, posted, failed, reversed), created_at (TIMESTAMP)
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a transaction entity data model, so that we can store transaction information securely
acceptance_criteria: Transaction entity has all required fields
Transaction amount is stored in decimal format

test_steps.expected_result: Transaction entity is created with all required fields

requirements.title: Security Pattern - Biometric Authentication
requirements.description: Biometric authentication used for transaction confirmation and order submission
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want my transactions to be secure, so that I can trust the banking app
acceptance_criteria: Biometric authentication successful
Transaction confirmed

requirements.title: Send Money to Contact Workflow
requirements.description: Step 1: User taps 'Send' quick action or navigates to Transfers tab. Step 2: User selects recipient and enters transfer amount. Step 3: Confirmation screen displays recipient name, amount, and availability time. Step 4: Backend processes transfer via FedNow or ACH. Step 5: Both sender and recipient receive push notification.
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to send money to a contact, so that they can receive the funds instantly.
acceptance_criteria: User can select recipient and enter transfer amount
Transfer is processed successfully via FedNow or ACH
Both sender and recipient receive push notification

test_steps.action: Select recipient and enter transfer amount
test_steps.expected_result: Confirmation screen displays recipient name, amount, and availability time

test_steps.action: Confirm transfer and process via FedNow or ACH
test_steps.expected_result: Transfer is successful and both sender and recipient receive push notification

assumptions: FedNow and ACH transfer services are available and functional
ambiguities: What happens if recipient's bank does not support FedNow?

requirements.title: Split Bill with Group Workflow
requirements.description: Step 1: User taps 'Split' from transaction details or Transfers tab. Step 2: User enters total bill amount and adds participants. Step 3: Split options are displayed, including equal split, percentage-based, and custom amounts. Step 4: Review screen shows each participant's share. Step 5: Organizer's dashboard shows real-time payment status per participant.
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to split a bill with a group, so that we can easily divide the cost.
acceptance_criteria: User can enter total bill amount and add participants
Split options are displayed, including equal split, percentage-based, and custom amounts
Organizer's dashboard shows real-time payment status per participant

test_steps.action: Enter total bill amount and add participants
test_steps.expected_result: Split options are displayed, including equal split, percentage-based, and custom amounts
Organizer's dashboard shows real-time payment status per participant

assumptions: Split bill feature is available and functional
ambiguities: What happens if participant does not pay their share?

requirements.title: Account Settings Page
requirements.description: Page for managing account settings, including physical debit card request, account statements, and transaction PIN
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to manage my account settings, so that I can control my account details
acceptance_criteria: Physical debit card request is successful
Account statements are generated monthly

test_steps.expected_result: Account settings page displays with required options

requirements.title: Transaction Details Page
requirements.description: Page for displaying transaction details, including merchant logo, location, and categorization
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to view my transaction details, so that I can track my spending
acceptance_criteria: Transaction details page displays merchant logo and location
Transaction categorization is accurate

test_steps.expected_result: Transaction details page displays with required information

assumptions: User has a valid account with transactions

requirements.title: Login Page
requirements.description: Page for logging in to the app, including biometric login options and transaction PIN
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to log in to the app, so that I can access my account
acceptance_criteria: Biometric login is successful
Transaction PIN is required for transfers over $500

test_steps.expected_result: Login page displays with required options

assumptions: User has a valid account with biometric authentication enabled

acceptance_criteria: Displays real-time price and daily chart for searched stock/ETF
Allows user to buy with market or limit order

test_steps.expected_result: Invest tab displays with stock search functionality
